summary: Compact Noether R121 Paper 20 no-duplicate audit. It verifies that the older RA49 formula (13) localized kappa/lambda repair and the RA87 Paper 20 clearpage boundary repair are already present in R121, so they should not be replayed onto the active web cumulative.
verification_summary: R121 already has formula (13) factor-sum indices varrho_kappa and sigma_lambda.
R121 correctly keeps nearby prose products as varrho_mu sigma_nu; do not make a broad kappa/lambda replacement.
R121 already has a clearpage between Paper 19 and Paper 20 before the Paper 20 footnote reset/section start.
limitations: No new TeX patch is included.
No source images, reader PDFs, or translations are included.
RA49's dense-formula witness was based on a source PDF whose embedded page images are about 360 PPI, despite 1000-DPI crop/render inspection; treat as localized best-available evidence only.
P20 remains queued for broader pagewise audit; this package is not P20 certification, not whole-corpus certification, and not a critical edition.
recommended_next_action: Use as a compact skip/anti-duplication guardrail for active Noether web work. Upload only as coordination/provenance evidence if useful; do not present it as reader output or source closure.
github_note: Corrections and source comparisons can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
